defects.title: Long malformed bootloader-prefix packets reset the CPU after control-line activity
defects.reproduction: 1EAF_NOT_A_RESET followed by LF after repeated DTR changes; RAM calibration/address canaries vanished
defects.fix: Require exactly four bytes in the reset hook

defects.title: Extreme finite calibration causes nonnumeric ovf replies
defects.fix: Check the complete numeric group against the formatter range before emitting output; return ERROR:NUMERIC RANGE

scope: Release stress qualification; deferred enhancements excluded

changes: Exact four-byte bootloader token after existing control-line arming
Whole-reply finite numeric range guard before Arduino Print

limitations: Unconnected inputs; no reference-voltage accuracy qualification
No physical RS485 peer or physical power-cut/I2C-fault fixture; those fault cases are modeled on host
V1-to-V2 migration not repeated; only V2.1.0-to-V2.1.1 update qualified in this run
A600-second soak and these probes do not prove absence of all possible faults
